title: Master Gadrin
wikitext:
{{npcbox | name = Master Gadrin | faction = Horde | city = Darkspear Trolls | level = 12 | race = Troll | creature = Humanoid | sex = Male | location = [[Sen'jin Village]] {{co|56|75|Durotar}} | image = Master Gadrin.jpg }} [[Master Gadrin]] is a level 12 [[quest giver]] located in [[Sen'jin Village]] in the [[orc]] and [[troll]] starting zone of [[Durotar]]. Gadrin is one of [[Vol'jin]]’s most trusted advisers. Along with a young witch doctor named [[Zalazane]], Gadrin led the mystical training of many [[Darkspear]] [[priest]]s and [[mage]]s. However, Zalazane went mad from the mystical forces he had unleashed. The crazed witch doctor placed a curse upon the [[Echo Isles]] and drove Gadrin and his brethren away. Now Gadrin seeks to end Zalazane’s rampage and put the souls of his cursed brethren to rest.
See [[List of Durotar NPCs]]. ==Quests== He starts the following quests: *{{questlong|Horde|7|Report to Orgnil}} *{{questlong|Horde|9|Minshina's Skull}} *{{questlong|Horde|10|Zalazane}} *{{questlong|Horde|45|The Spider God}} (Dungeon) *{{questlong|Horde|55|Summoning Shadra}} (Elite) {{DEFAULTSORT:Gadrin, Master}} [[Category:Troll quest givers]] [[Category:Durotar NPCs]]
